title: 'travel to a known place' only offers 'landmark' rooms, and which visited rooms qualify as landmarks is not predictable from the fiction: Twin Stones and Old Watchtower became fast-travel landmarks, but equally named, content-bearing rooms visited in the same walk (Camp Smoke, Gray Cairn, Widow's Well) never appeared in the travel list, so returning to them required manual re-walking with no way to tell in advance which rooms would be reachable by fast travel.
where: The Vale of Ash wood, 'travel to a known place' menu
